project.name: Jarvis AI
project.purpose: Multimodal AI assistant with chat, live voice/video call, dual-screen live translation, TTS studio, personal knowledge base + RAG, semantic search, and GitHub Gist 2-way sync.

architecture.pattern: module-based vanilla JS, shared state exposed on window, IndexedDB for persistence, localStorage for settings/keys, native bridge in Android WebView
external_apis: Google Gemini (chat + BidiGenerateContent live streaming + TTS + embeddings)
Tavily / Serper / Jina / Brave (web search and content extraction)

files.index.html: Main UI skeleton: sidebar, header, chat, modals, input panel, file upload, transcript, token/latency bar, search/memory toggles.
files.manifest.json: PWA manifest (icons, display, theme color, app name, start URL).
files.sw.js: Service Worker: static asset cache, network-first for HTML/JS/CSS, bypass for live/API/search endpoints, cache CDN libs.
files.css/style.css: Core UI styles, layout, sidebar, chat bubbles, modals, inputs, theme variables.

features.name: Chat, sessions, models, core app logic

files.js/app.js: Main controller: session management, chat history, rendering (markdown + thinking blocks), model/engine selection, API key wiring, system instruction + global context, temperature/top-p/top-k/thinking level, file attachments, auto-naming, auto-summary, branch-forking, hands-free voice recorder + VAD, token/latency counters, DOM helpers, PWA SW registration, localStorage quota handling, native bridge sync hooks.
files.js/database.js: IndexedDB persistence for sessions and related stores, init + CRUD helpers.
files.js/api-keys.js: API key pool UI + storage, key rotation, quota/usage tracking wiring, external config storage.
files.js/commands.js: Command palette / prompt library / slash-command routing helpers.
files.js/tools.js: Search cache, Tavily/Serper helpers, web page + YouTube content extraction, blob save/share, copy helpers, export helpers.

files.js/live.js: Gemini bidirectional live WebSocket (BidiGenerateContent), PCM streaming (16kHz in, 24kHz playback), camera streaming, live speech recognition, farewell/silence hangup detection, tool calls for search_web/read_url, key rotation on disconnect, transcript capture synced back to chat.

files.js/translate.js: Bilingual interpretation via Gemini live translate/bidirectional model, speaker toggle, VU meter, local SpeechRecognition transcript, model/key fallback, guest language selection, screen flip helper.

files.js/tts.js: Gemini TTS studio, voice presets, expression tags, smart chunking, WAV construction, MP3 encode (lamejs), visualizer, playback, IndexedDB TTS library, history list with play/download/delete.

features.name: Personal knowledge base, RAG, embeddings, semantic search

files.js/rag.js: Gemini Embedding 2 (+ fallback embedding-001), in-browser cosine similarity, IndexedDB vector store, document chunking with overlap, indexing with progress, hybrid vector + lexical search, smart intent filter for personal-identity queries, context retrieval for chat, auto-learn memory extraction, persona synthesis, knowledge modal UI.

features.name: GitHub Gist 2-way sync and multi-device merge

files.js/sync.js: GitHub Gist 2-way sync with smart merge for sessions, knowledge base, folders, prompts, API keys/external configs, key-usage counters, medications + med history, tombstone handling, rate-limit recovery, background auto-sync, startup sync, pull/push restore flows, sync header status.

features.name: Android WebView wrapper and medication reminders

files.android/gradle.properties: Gradle JVM args + AndroidX/R class settings.
files.android/app/build.gradle: App module config: versioning, permissions, packaging, WebView assets.
files.android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml: Permissions and components: alarms, notifications, boot receiver, WebView activity.
files.android/app/src/main/java/com/kevinkieu/: WebView setup, JS bridge for native persistence/alarms, medication reminder integration.
files.android/app/src/main/res/*: UI resources: layout, strings, colors, themes, icons.
files.android/app/src/main/assets/*: Bundled web app assets for offline APK (index.html, manifest, sw.js, css/, js/, icons).
files.build-apk.bat: Windows script: bump version, copy web assets into Android assets, assemble release APK.
files.installphone.bat: Install built APK to device via USB ADB.
files.installphone-wifi.bat: Install built APK to device via Wi-Fi debugging ADB.

files.scratch/test_browser.js: Likely a quick browser/launch test helper.
files..well-known/assetlinks.json: Android app links / asset links metadata.

browser.localStorage: Settings, API keys (optionally obfuscated), folders, tabs, theme, sync config, medication data, deleted-id tombstones, key usage data
browser.indexeddb: Chat sessions, knowledge/vector store, TTS history, file/TTS-related stores

android.webview: Runs the same web app with bundled assets
android.native: AlarmManager/NotificationManager for medication reminders, RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED rescheduling, notification actions (taken/snooze), JS bridge for persistence

developer_workflow.local_run: Serve the project via a local HTTP server (for example Python http.server / npx serve) and open index.html.
developer_workflow.pwa_install: Install from browser via manifest/Service Worker.
developer_workflow.android_build: Run build-apk.bat on Windows to bump version, bundle web assets, and assemble release APK.
developer_workflow.android_deploy: Use installphone.bat or installphone-wifi.bat to install to a connected device.
developer_workflow.version_bump: Run bump-version.js to increment Android versionCode/versionName and sync cache busters in index.html and sw.js.
